cost_tiebreak.aliases: Canonical paid jobs are counted once. Reuse/aliases add zero calls and zero independent observations; preserve their links without multiplying costs or evidence.
cost_tiebreak.arithmetic: Decimal arithmetic from original decimal receipt strings; no rounded display numbers in comparisons.
cost_tiebreak.completeness: An unknown call is not free. If known usage plus retained reservations do not provide a documented conservative bound, report cost incomplete and use +infinity for the cost tiebreak until accounting is resolved. Do not discard the cell.
cost_tiebreak.definition: For this configuration and both researchers, sum unique attributable build and prediction jobs: known conservative usage charges PLUS retained uncertain reservation amounts not already included in those usage charges.
cost_tiebreak.producer_accounting: Shared embedding charges are reported once under their canonical producer, not copied into every consumer or alias. They belong to the control-cost ledger, not these core P1-P8 jobs.

existing_metric_definition.declared_promotion_policy: Before scores: attempt the full 48-configuration grid with one extraction per researcher if approved source count and measured throughput allow. Promote one configuration within each family plus two global configurations not already selected, using paired development accuracy, coverage, and cost (deterministic config ID tie-break); obtain two further extraction replicates for promoted configs and rank across all three. Unpromoted configs get further replicates only if time/allocation permit. Keep all omitted/incomplete cells visible. No source-independent fidelity means no fidelity winner and no FINALISTS_FROZEN claim; extraction readiness may still be studied separately.
existing_metric_definition.finding: Existing accuracy is count(correct delivered valid choices)/all scheduled rows. Invalid/missing choices contribute zero; conditional Brier is separate. No conflicting numerical promotion formula found.
existing_metric_definition.interpretation: This receipt makes the previously named accuracy, coverage, cost, config-ID ordering operational without changing any primary outcome or denominator.

primary_operational_metrics.C: Sum of correct AND valid delivered rows over the two 14-row researcher cells.
primary_operational_metrics.V: Sum of valid delivered rows over the two 14-row researcher cells.
primary_operational_metrics.conditional_valid_accuracy: C / V if V > 0, else null. Report separately; never substitute into promotion ranking.
primary_operational_metrics.delivered_correct_fraction: C / 28; alias accuracy_all_scheduled. Equal to the mean of the two researcher-specific delivered-correct fractions because both have 14 rows.
primary_operational_metrics.probability_metrics: Report valid-probability coverage and existing mean squared multiclass Brier on valid probability vectors separately. They do not break promotion ties.
primary_operational_metrics.valid_choice_coverage: V / 28. This is the coverage tiebreak, not probability coverage or build-validity rate.

promotion_algorithm.all_zero_family: Choose its highest-ranked feasible configuration under the same rule and label it an exploratory replication allocation with no positive fidelity evidence.
promotion_algorithm.next_replicates: Request replicate IDs1 and2 for each promoted configuration and both researchers under the original sparse corpus/runtime/settings, subject to coordinator budget/deadline authorization. Receipt itself grants no calls.
promotion_algorithm.result: Ten unique configurations if each family has an eligible configuration and at least two remaining eligible configurations. Otherwise report the missing slot; never substitute an ineligible configuration.
promotion_algorithm.step1: Keep all 48 configurations and 96 cells in reports. Filter only the four structurally impossible configurations from replication eligibility.
promotion_algorithm.step2: Sort eligible configurations once by the exact ranking key. For each family P1 through P8, choose its highest-ranked configuration.
promotion_algorithm.step3: From that same global ordered list, select the first two configurations not already selected in step2. Extras may belong to any family; do not duplicate a configuration.
promotion_algorithm.subsequent_aggregation: When the promoted three-replicate schedule is frozen, report delivered-correct and coverage over all84 planned ordered rows per configuration (28x3), preserving missing scheduled replications. Keep unpromoted one-replicate screening results separate; do not compare denominators as though replication were matched.

purpose: Allocate further extraction replicates in an exploratory development search; not a fidelity winner, confirmed best method or FINALISTS_FROZEN event.

ranking.exact_ties: Unrounded integer C/V and Decimal cost define ties. No score tolerance, conditional accuracy, Brier, order consistency or post-hoc utility enters the tiebreak.
ranking.meaning_of_paired: All configurations use the same fixed item/order schedule. Ranking is absolute delivered-correct fraction on that matched schedule, not a score divided by available cases or an unspecified baseline-relative gain. Baseline deltas remain separate paired reports.

replication_feasibility_filter.if_new_impossibility_found: Record it without silently expanding this filter after scores; requires an explicit revised feasibility policy and preservation of the original ranking.
replication_feasibility_filter.other_failures: All other failed configurations remain rankable. A low or zero observed score is not an eligibility filter.
replication_feasibility_filter.reason: P3/P5 at cap512 have a demonstrated required-schema/nonempty-rule byte lower bound above the cap for these source IDs; same-runtime/cap replication cannot repair that structural impossibility.

scope.controls_and_hybrids: Descriptive matched comparators only; not additional P1-P8 configurations eligible for these ten promotion slots.
scope.richer_comparison: Report the same operational metrics separately for richer-fit. Its frozen source-only comparison does not select a winner or change which sparse grid receives promotion. Never pool sparse/richer as extra replicates of one intervention.

separate_required_reports.order_consistency: Report semantic choice consistency across reversed orders and valid-pair coverage separately; the two orderings are coupled observations.
separate_required_reports.paired_all_scheduled: Also report the all-planned-row accuracy difference with invalid/missing outcomes treated as zero correct. Do not relabel this as conditional agreement.
separate_required_reports.paired_joint_valid: For each named comparison, restrict conditional paired accuracy differences to the identical item/order IDs valid in both arms; report the exact joint-valid denominator and both full-schedule coverages. For sparse/richer paired prediction analysis also require both corresponding build cells valid.
separate_required_reports.per_researcher: Always report Neel and Chris metrics separately before pooled operational allocation counts. Their source-group counts remain2 and1.
separate_required_reports.selection_bias: Promotion and follow-up use development data. They do not establish generalization, a fidelity winner or final-test validity.
separate_required_reports.uncertainty: Source-group-aware descriptive resampling by researcher. No meaningful interval for the one-group Chris panel; repeated orderings/replicates/aliases do not add source independence.

cases: all-scheduled correct outranks better conditional accuracy
retained uncertain reservations increase tied cost
unbounded unknown cost is never zero/free
ASCII config ID breaks exact ties
family/global selection yields ten unique eligible configs while preserving96-cell coverage

timing.scoring_gate: Wait for extra12 and matched controls to complete with immutable result pins. No partial-score promotion.

valid_delivery.definition: A row passes the pinned evaluator choice validity and manifest/source/profile/item/order/consumer provenance checks. Status complete or ok; a valid option letter; finite confidence in [0,1]; supplied probability vectors must be valid and agree with chosen-option confidence.
valid_delivery.denominator: All 28 predeclared ordered rows remain, including every row under an invalid/empty/unavailable build or structural omission. Do not fabricate provider predictions for absent rows; derive explicit operational failure outcomes from the frozen cell schedule.
valid_delivery.failure_statuses: Missing, invalid, abstained, empty, unavailable, unsupported, unscheduled or not-dispatched outcomes contribute neither a valid delivery nor a delivered correct choice.
